newsitem.title: USA: US Restaurant holders approve conversion.
newsitem.headline: US Restaurant holders approve conversion.

text.p: U.S. Restaurant Properties Master LP said on Friday that a proposal to convert the company to a real estate investment trust had won 77 percent approval on the company's outstanding shares.
U.S. Restaurant said the vote was taken at a special meeting of its limited partners on Friday morning.

"As a REIT, U.S. Restaurant Properties will maintain the flow-through tax advantages that we have enjoyed as a partnership," said company President Bob Stetson, in a statement released before the vote.
"Furthermore, the REIT structure will provide us with access to lower-cost debt financing, which should increase profits and the cash available for dividends," he said.
The company said it plans to convert from a master limited partnership to the REIT in the third quarter.
U.S. Restaurant Properties Master LP owns 449 restaurant properties, including properties where Burger King, Arby's and Chili's are operated.
